summary: EIP-8333 合并为 Draft：epoch N 的 FFG checkpoint 从 N 第一个 slot 的区块改为 N 之前的最后一个区块，消除迟到区块分裂首个委员会投票的竞态，并修正“epoch N 最终确定其实还多一个区块”的差一问题。kassandraETH 改进 kohaku-cli，现在可在一个 UserOp 中解除多个 Tornado 票据的屏蔽。gakonst 发布 Solidus 形式化验证 EVM 编译器的挑战。

items.title: 新 EIP：Align Checkpoint with Epoch Boundary Block
items.note: （wemeetagain）合并为 Draft，即 EIP-8333。checkpoint 所在 epoch 不变，只是根改变，通过新的 `get_checkpoint_root` 用于 attestation 处理、justification、fork choice 和验证者指南。目前 target 区块与首个委员会投票在同一 slot，迟到的区块会分裂投票，每个 epoch 都有可测的损失；边界区块在 epoch 开始前已知，竞态随之消失。
items.title_en: New EIP: Align Checkpoint with Epoch Boundary Block
items.note_en: (wemeetagain), merged as a Draft, EIP-8333. Checkpoint epochs stay the same and only the root changes, through a new `get_checkpoint_root` helper used in attestation processing, justification, fork choice and the validator guide. Today the target block is proposed in the same slot the first committee votes, so a late block splits their votes, a measurable loss every epoch; the boundary block is known before the epoch starts, so the race disappears.

keywords_en: EIP-8333 aligns checkpoint with epoch boundary block
kohaku-cli unshields multiple Tornado notes in one UserOp
summary_en: EIP-8333 merged as a Draft: epoch N's FFG checkpoint moves from the block at N's first slot to the last block before N, removing the race where a late block splits the first committee's votes and fixing the off-by-one where "epoch N finalized" really meant one extra block. kassandraETH improved kohaku-cli, which can now unshield multiple Tornado notes in one UserOp. gakonst published challenges for Solidus, a formally verified EVM compiler.
